name: sol-luna-command-center
description: GPT-5.6 Sol command center: build bounded execution packets, dispatch to ChatGPT Web GPT-5.6 Luna Max or local luna_worker, ingest results, and summarize.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with Sol, execute bounded packets via ChatGPT Web Luna Max or a local luna_worker.
interface.longDescription: Turns Sol (this Codex session) into the command center of a two-agent loop: it packs a bounded, hash-verified execution packet from a spec JSON, hands it to ChatGPT Web GPT-5.6 Luna Max (desktop browser or manual paste) or to the local luna_worker agent via codex exec, then ingests the SHA-256-bound result and records the final summary. Packets follow a one-way state machine (new, done, ingested, summarized) with strict refusal on tampering, out-of-order steps, oversized payloads, and unsupported transports. Includes a doctor self-check, an idempotent init, a per-packet dispatch lock, and full test suites for Windows PowerShell and POSIX shells.
defaultPrompt: Run the sol-luna doctor self-check and report what is missing.
Create an execution packet from a spec JSON and dispatch it.
Show the status of all sol-luna execution packets.
